services.name: NYU Tandon Bridge Program
services.desc: Prepare for graduate study or career advancement with NYU Tandon’s 100% online, self-paced Bridge Program. The NYU Tandon Bridge Program helps learners from non-technical backgrounds gain the knowledge and confidence to succeed in today’s technology-driven world. Developed and taught by faculty in the Department of Computer Science and Engineering, the Bridge Program provides a rigorous introduction to computer science fundamentals, mathematical reasoning, and programming. Whether you’re preparing for a STEM graduate program or pivoting into a technical role in industry, the Bridge certificate demonstrates your ability to master core computing concepts and apply them in real-world contexts.
